**Best move:** Re8+

**Main line:** Re8+ Rxe8 Qxe8+ Kg7

**Motif:** fork

**Explanation:**
The rook on e7 has a hidden power—it can deliver check while simultaneously attacking Black's undefended rook on a8. When you play Re8+, you force Black to capture with Rxe8 (the only legal move), after which Qxe8+ wins the rook. Before calculating tactics, always scan for pieces that are undefended and see if a forcing move can attack two targets at once. That's how you spot forks—one move, two threats.
